outcome: associated risk factors for obstetric hysterectomy
maternal morbidity associated with obstetric hysterectomy
maternal mortality associated with obstetric hysterectomy
fetal mortality associated with obstetric hysterectomy
cohort: 41 women who underwent obstetric hysterectomy at a tertiary care academic referral centre between July 2005 and June 2010.
finding: The frequency of obstetric hysterectomy was 22.9/10,000 births, with the main indications being uterine rupture and postpartum hemorrhage (31.7% each), followed by morbidly adherent placenta (21.9%).
